documents.title: Punched Paper Tape #409

documents.title: Commissary Requisition Voucher #112
documents.material: Triplicate carbon copy on grey pulp paper
documents.physical_description: Faded purple hectograph ink. Stamped with the triangular seal of the Provincial Grain Directorate. Smudged with coal soot.
documents.transcript: ISSUED TO: Sapper Morozov, G. // COMMODITY: 50kg Ammonium Nitrate, 2 rolls safety fuse // RATIONALE: Canal lock clearance // AUTHORIZED BY: Voss, V. (Col.) // NOTE: Do not inform township.

documents.title: Slag Chemistry Note from Master Blacksmith
documents.material: Reverse side of a 1982 wall calendar
documents.physical_description: Scrawled in graphite pencil with thumbprints of red hematite dust. Calculations crossed out twice in frustration.
documents.transcript: Lime ratio must stay at 1.4 or the silica eats the firebricks in 40 hours. If the children skip the dolomite wash on the ladle linings, the molten lead will crack the iron floor. Tell Katya no books during the tap.

documents.title: Coroner's Lead Shroud Tag #031
documents.material: Stamped lead sheet with copper wire tie
documents.physical_description: Heavy, malleable metal tag with stamped alphanumeric characters. Oxidized white around the edges.
documents.transcript: NAME: VEL, IRINA // OCCUPATION: Chief Medical Officer // CAUSE: Progressive pulmonary fibrosis / chronic internal emitter (Cs-137) // CULPABILITY: Zero // FINAL POSSESSION: 1 brass key ring (passed to Sonya).

documents.title: Station 0 Geostationary Orbital Track Chart
documents.material: Drafting vellum overlaid on blueprint grid
documents.physical_description: Hand-plotted hyperbolic curves drawn with black india ink and red drafting pencil. Multiple orbital intersections marked with small asterisks.
documents.transcript: CONSTELLATION: HARROW-4 // PERIGEE: 184 KM (CRITICAL) // APOGEE: 790 KM // BALLISTIC PREDICTION: Impact footprint spans Tessarat Valley between Day 720 and 740. Shield the roof or evacuate below -50m.
